title: Finite perfect markings admit a normalized etale presheaf presentation
statement: Let X,d,φ,M,V,T be a scheme, an adic coefficient datum on A, coefficient comparisons, a derived completed-coefficient object, an etale X-chart and a supplied algebraic tower respectively, with φ isomorphisms satisfying quotient/scalar compatibility [lem-weil-pbc-residue-perfect-finite-quotient-models], all T.level(n) perfect, and separate local markings [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-stalk-models]. Then a FinitePerfectAdicIsomorphismPresentation [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-isomorphism-presentation] exists. It supplies descended etale diagrams, Isom presheaf reductions with etale generator squares, and explicit realization functors with coefficient interchange and actual/model normalization identities. Transport of raw isomorphisms and preservation of a raw normalization square are separately constructed and proved from these identities. This is before pro-etale section evaluation or proof of the finite locally constant Isom-sheaf predicate.

source.place: Tag 09C6, finite quotient descent and normalized algebraic diagram before any inverse limit; Tag 09BV, etale Isom presheaves; Tag 06YY, universal normalization arrows.

proof.text: Apply the actual finite quotient descent and scalar normalization lemma against the explicitly defined constant algebraic levels. This supplies K, its sourcewise universal arrows, Isom stalks and the actual/model realization comparisons.
The proved constant cohomology lemma supplies boundedness and finite lisse cohomology of C. Its normalization lemma supplies coherent universal constant arrows.

For each adjacent pair apply the proved generic universal-normalization presheaf construction. It constructs p by universal factors, proves its naturality by the pulled normalization square and uniqueness, and supplies the generator normalization equation. Choose these maps at all levels and assemble the original presentation fields.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdic_isomorphism_presentation
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d)
    (hperfect : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n))
    (hmark : FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M V T) :
    Nonempty (FinitePerfectAdicIsomorphismPresentation X d M V T)
